description.p: Papiro is a modern, cross-platform text editor designed for developers and writers who value focus and efficiency.

ul.li: Multiple cursors and selections for simultaneous editing
Macro recording and playback for automating repetitive tasks
Clip library for managing frequently used text snippets
Translations for Portuguese, English, and Spanish

description.p: Built with a focus on performance and a distraction-free interface.

release.description: Fixed the invisible dark-theme tab close button and unified the launcher, dock and window icons.
Tab close buttons, keyboard shortcuts translations, fixed icon installation.
Fluent Design interface, custom Windows title bar, and a language selector in Preferences.
Print preview, Java/JDK integration, real diff hunks, virtual-space cursor and TextPad feature parity.
LSP integration with completion and hover, Git diff viewer and inline blame.
